chatRow.shellIntegrationMessage: The command did run, but this terminal has no VS Code shell integration, so era harness can only read output from a terminal snapshot: no live output, no reliable end-of-command detection, and long-running commands (over 3 seconds) may be truncated.
chatRow.shellIntegrationCheck1: Search for terminal.integrated.shellIntegration.enabled in Settings and make sure it is checked.
chatRow.shellIntegrationCheck2: Use PowerShell 7 (pwsh) or bash as the default profile; unsupported shells and custom launch arguments disable shell integration.
chatRow.shellIntegrationCheck3: Raise the shell integration timeout to 8 seconds (Settings → Terminal); 4 seconds is often too short for PowerShell startup.
chatRow.shellIntegrationRecommendation: Since you're experiencing repeated shell integration issues, we recommend switching to Background Terminal mode for better reliability.

featureTips.doubleCheckCompletion: Enable "Double-Check Completion" in settings to have era harness verify its work before finishing a task.
featureTips.clinerulesFile: Add a .clinerules file to your project root to give era harness project-specific instructions.
featureTips.planMode: Switch to Plan Mode to discuss and plan an approach before era harness takes action.
featureTips.useAtContext: Use @ in the chat input to add files, folders, or URLs as context for your task.
featureTips.mcpServers: Set up MCP Servers to give era harness access to external tools and APIs.
featureTips.checkpoints: era harness creates checkpoints after changes — you can always restore to a previous state.
featureTips.compactCommand: Use /compact to condense long conversations and free up context window space.
featureTips.autoApprove: Enable auto-approve for read-only tools like file reads to speed up exploration.
featureTips.quoteButton: Use the quote button to select text from era harness's response and reference it in your reply.
featureTips.dragDropImages: You can drag and drop images into the chat to share screenshots with era harness.
featureTips.browseWebsites: era harness can browse websites — ask it to test your local dev server in the browser.
featureTips.reportBug: Use /reportbug to quickly file a GitHub issue with diagnostic context included.
featureTips.disableTips: You can disable these tips in Settings → Features → "Feature Tips".
